duration: Starts Spring 2027; about two years including paid apprenticeship
pay_detail: First year: monthly stipend, plus help with books, supplies and transportation. Second year: paid apprentice. Career and College Promise helps cover tuition.
name: WakeWorks Youth Apprenticeship Academy
org: Wake Tech Community College with Wake County Public School System
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors learn on the job in skilled trades, car and truck tech, or advanced making of goods. In year two you work for a partner employer. You are a paid Registered Youth Apprentice.
who_can_apply: Juniors in Wake County Public School System high schools. Talk to your career development coordinator or CTE teacher.
deadline_text: Applications are being accepted for Spring 2027. Application deadline is October 16 (2026).
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Wake Tech page for the apprenticeship academy. You can also ask for help from the career coordinator at your school.
notes: The deadline is very close. Paths are building trades (carpentry, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, welding), car and truck tech, and mechanical engineering and advanced making. The page gives no year with the October 16 date. It follows the Spring 2027 wording. The page says Career and College Promise helps cover tuition. It does not say tuition is fully paid.
